items.defectStatement: TotalDocs iterates b.cache without cacheMu while BuildIndex can modify that map, causing a data race and potentially a fatal concurrent map iteration/write. The startup log calls TotalDocs after starting the event goroutine that can build indexes; Prometheus collection also calls it.
obligations: Synchronize all cache map access in TotalDocs with BuildIndex's cacheMu-protected writes.
Preserve summing successful document counts and skipping indexes whose DocCount returns an error.
Release any acquired lock on return and preserve BuildIndex's protected cache insertion.
items.notes: The finding's historical claim is incorrect: locking only BuildIndex never synchronized an unlocked TotalDocs reader. An exclusive lock or copying index references under the lock before counting is also valid. The closing brace at line 154 is outside the replacement.

items.defectStatement: BuildIndex locks only cache publication, allowing concurrent calls for the same key to create and populate indexes simultaneously. This duplicates expensive work, races creation of the same disk directory, and allows successful builds to overwrite each other's cached index.
obligations: Prevent same-key builds from executing index creation, population, and flushing concurrently.
Keep cache publication synchronized and publish only successfully populated and flushed indexes.
Release build synchronization on every return path and preserve error propagation.
items.notes: Synchronization must begin before index creation; changing lines 137–140 cannot prevent work already performed. The diff provides enough context to restore whole-function locking, although per-key synchronization permits unrelated builds to proceed independently. Serialization alone does not coalesce queued requests. The actual disk path is Root/Namespace/Resource.Group.
